acceptance: The chosen mechanism is implemented with a bounded end-to-end test.
A scope amendment, if allowed, is visible in show_batch and in final evidence, and a path outside amended scope is still refused.
description:
Across 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-10, batches were aborted or re-registered because a needed file was outside the frozen scope: tpc-timer-boundaries (docs-ownership.json), arrow-result-fetch, server-engine-bulk-load (twice; make/platform-tests.mk and tests/uat files), ci-and-preflight-reliability. Each abort costs a re-land of every member plus a new CI cycle. batch-advance REASON=fix refuses paths outside the union of scopes, and scopes are immutable by design (batch-feature-delivery.md).

Change. Reduce the cost without weakening the audit: (a) batch-start warns when a member's changed or likely-coupled files (compose files with guards, quality/*.json, make/*.mk named in tests) fall outside scope; (b) allow an owner-recorded scope amendment that is hashed into the ledger and the receipt, applying only to the integration head forward; or (c) document a standard broad scope template. Batch tooling ships serially.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment if user-facing; no live cloud without owner approval quoted in context; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
